model: Broker-dealer FCFE at cost of equity (engine route), net debt zero, equity retention on balance-sheet growth, NCI and perpetual-bond distributions charged in the flow

equity_bridge.note: Zero-coupon CB due 2027, conversion price HK$19.82, 108.5m shares included in shares_outstanding; the liability is cancelled on conversion so its principal is added to equity value. Interim H1 2026 lines 2104-2115. Out of the money at the current price; treatment moves the per-share value by <0.5%.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: terminal nominal growth for a mature Chinese broker (China nominal GDP ~4-5% less structural fee compression and a share count that has only grown by placings), bracketed by revenue 5yr CAGR 5.2% and ordinary-equity/BVPS 5yr CAGR 5.7%; the DCF's base revenue path normalises down 15% over FY2027-28 then runs 4% -> 3%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: 3-year CAGRs (revenue 13.7%, EPS 18.1%, net income 20.0%) are measured from the FY2022 trough to the FY2025 upcycle and are cycle, not trend; the 5-year CAGRs (revenue 5.2%, EPS 4.9%, ordinary equity 5.7%) agree within 30% of each other and are the trend. Equity CAGR is NOT used as the growth rate; it is used to size retained equity.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are null: a broker's reported FCF (OCF - capex) is client-money, repo and trading-book flow (+40.2bn FY2018, -51.5bn FY2021, +39.4bn FY2022, -56.3bn FY2025). Ordinary equity = equity attributable to owners less OtherEquityInstruments (perpetual subordinated bonds): FY2020 98,162 -> FY2022 109,156 -> FY2025 129,511 -> H1 2026 138,148 (RMB m); BVPS 12.88 -> 14.32 -> 17.03 -> 17.65 RMB. Dividends per share RMB0.40 (FY2024) -> 0.60 (FY2025: 0.10 interim + 0.50 final) -> 0.25 interim FY2026; FY2025 payout 36% of ordinary profit (0.60 x 7,606 = 4,564 / 12,783).

scenario_narratives.base: Revenue normalises ~15% below the FY2026E boom level by FY2028 and then grows 4% fading to 3%; pre-tax margin 37%, deductions (tax + NCI + perpetual coupons) ~31% of PBT, ordinary equity retained to grow 4% -> 3%. FCFE ~RMB7-8bn in FY2027-30 rising to ~RMB11bn by FY2036; through-cycle ROE ~8.5% against an 11% cost of equity gives a terminal P/B ~0.7x.
scenario_narratives.bull: A multi-year bull market: revenue only dips 3% then compounds 5-6%, margin 40%, balance sheet deployed at 5%/yr, ROE reaches the 11% cost of equity. FCFE ~RMB10bn in FY2027 rising to ~RMB16.5bn; terminal P/B ~1.05x. This is where the sell-side's HK$21-22 mean target sits.
scenario_narratives.bear: A FY2022-23 downturn from a larger cost base: revenue -25% then -8%, margin troughs at 28% and recovers to 32%, ROE ~5-6%. FCFE ~RMB2-5bn in FY2027-28, below the ordinary dividend, so the payout is funded by perpetuals or cut; terminal P/B ~0.4x, where the H share traded in 2022-24.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A securities broker is worth the equity cash flow it can distribute after funding its own balance-sheet growth, discounted at the cost of equity. For GF Securities that flow is net profit to ordinary shareholders (after tax, GF Fund's 45.5% minority and the RMB1.2bn/yr of perpetual-bond coupons that sit inside 'profit attributable to owners') less the equity retained to grow ordinary shareholders' equity with the business. Reported FCF (+39bn to -56bn) is client-money and trading-book flow and is ignored; net debt is zero by construction because the RMB260bn of borrowings and bonds fund the margin and trading books. The valuation is a through-cycle ROE question: GF earned 8.6% on ordinary equity on average over FY2019-25 and ~16% annualised in H1 2026 at the top of the cycle; the base case normalises to ~8.5% against an 11% cost of equity, worth ~0.7x book against the 0.81x the H share trades at. Bull is ROE at the cost of equity (1.0x book, where the sell-side sits); bear is the 0.4x book the stock saw in 2022-24.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cyclicality: FY2026E is a boom year (H1 profit +80%, turnover +97%); the base case assumes a 15% revenue normalisation, the bear a 31% fall. If H2 2026 turnover stays at H1 levels the fy0 revenue base is ~2-3bn too low; if Q3 2026 (due late October) shows the market has already turned, the base path is too generous.
Trading-book marks: net investment gains were RMB15.0bn in H1 2026 vs 12.8bn for all of FY2025 and included a derivatives loss in FY2025; a mark-to-market reversal flows straight through PBT.

Capital allocation: ordinary equity has compounded 5.7%/yr while ROE averaged 8.6%, i.e. below the cost of equity; every RMB retained at that return destroys ~20% of its value. The model charges retention at 3-4%/yr; faster balance-sheet growth (H1 2026 assets +22%) at sub-CoE returns lowers the value.

Dilution: the January 2026 placing was 219m shares at an 8.4% discount and the HK$2.15bn CB converts at HK$19.82; the flat share count assumes no further placing. Perpetuals (RMB38.6bn, 3.17%) rank ahead of ordinary equity and their coupon is a fixed charge against a cyclical PBT.

Regulatory/compliance: CSRC sanctions suspended GF's sponsor and bond-underwriting licences for a year in 2020-21; fee caps on brokerage and public-fund management compress the two largest revenue lines; state-driven consolidation (Guotai Haitong, CICC-Dongxing-Cinda) creates larger rivals.

Currency and withholding: RMB flows against an HKD quote -- a 10% RMB move is a 10% move in the HKD value; the 10% H-share dividend withholding tax is not modelled; the A share trades at a ~35% premium that is not a parity check.

Sell-side (H-share targets HK$17-26, mean ~21.5, Buy consensus) sits at this model's bull case: the street capitalises FY2026E earnings at ~8-9x; this model capitalises a normalised ROE at an 11% cost of equity. The gap is the cycle view and the discount rate (at 10% the base value rises materially -- see the sensitivity grid).

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (1776.HK, HKD) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 14.15-21.08. FX CNYHKD=X and 000776.SZ from the same API on the same date.
data_sources.financials: 1776.HK_Metrics.csv / metrics_normalized (FY2018-FY2025 annual, H1 2023-H1 2026 interim, Q1/Q3 2024-2026, RMB millions) built from the HKEX annual, interim and quarterly reports in Extracted/; kpis table for NetIncomeInclNCI, OtherEquityInstruments, InterestIncome, DividendsPaid, ProfitBeforeTax, CashTaxesPaid, OperatingRevenuePRC. H1 2026 interim: key indicators (line 431-457: total revenue and other income, PBT, attributable profit, equity per share incl./excl. perpetuals), income statement (line 6480-6520), balance sheet (line 6740-6762: share capital, other equity instruments, equity attributable, NCI), note 48 perpetual bonds (line 9535-9565), net capital and risk-control indicators (line 477-504), H placing and CB (line 2098-2150, 4622-4640), interim dividend proposal (line 3058-3090). FY2025 annual: five-year key data (total revenue and other income, PBT, attributable profit, equity, ROE 10.16%), income statement (line 14085-14112), dividends to other equity instrument holders RMB918m (line 19452), final dividend RMB5.00/10 shares (line 8242). FY2024 annual: dividend RMB4.00/10 shares (line 8557).
data_sources.qualitative: 1776.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-17), read after the drivers were drafted and before the final build; it confirmed them (H1 2026 +80% profit within the +85% alert; risk coverage 233%; interim dividend RMB2.5/10 shares; CB terms; consolidation and sanction history; sell-side targets). Outlook and risk context also taken from the H1 2026 interim MD&A and the FY2025 annual report chairman's statement and risk sections.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E total revenue, RMB m, on the IFRS 'Total revenue' line (commission and fee income + interest income + net investment gains, BEFORE 'other income and gains or losses'), which is what the CSV Revenue column carries: H1 2026 actual 34,209 (interim income statement, line 6490-6494: 12,597 + 6,624 + 14,987) + H2 2026E 24,800 (H2 2025 actual 24,505 = 44,287 - 19,782, held flat: turnover cooled from the H1 peak, the H share is 20% off its 52-week high). FY2025 actual 44,287. The 'Total revenue and other income' line (31,751 H1 2026; 44,513 FY2025) and the PRC-GAAP 'operating revenue' quoted in the press (RMB26.9bn H1 2026) are different definitions and are not used.
inputs.share_count_basis: 7,824,845,511 A + H ordinary shares after the 219,000,000-share H placing completed 2026-01-14 (interim line 4622, 4635) PLUS 108,476,287 H shares from full conversion of the HK$2.15bn zero-coupon H-share convertible bonds due 2027 at the initial conversion price HK$19.82 (interim line 2112-2115) = 7,933.3m fully diluted; the bond principal (CNY 1,834m) is added back in equity_bridge on the if-converted basis. Held FLAT thereafter: SBC-zero (basic = diluted EPS until the CB; no share scheme disclosed), the FY2025 buyback-and-cancellation was 15.2m shares (7,621.1m -> 7,605.8m) and is not a repeating lever, and no further placing is assumed. A further discounted placing in the next bull market is the dilution risk the flat count ignores.
inputs.debt_cash_note: Broker-dealer: the CSV TotalDebt (RMB259,682m at H1 2026 = borrowings + short-term financing payables + bonds payable + long-term loans) and the repo book fund the margin-financing and trading books; cash (RMB27,815m) sits beside RMB1.19tn of assets that include segregated client money. Neither is surplus or a claim on the equity flow. Net debt is zero by construction on the FCFE route; nothing is bridged after the flows except the convertible-bond principal on the if-converted share count.
inputs.fcf_note: last_fcf is FY2026E FCFE = net profit attributable to ORDINARY shareholders ~17,900 (PBT ~25,500 = H1 15,720 + H2E ~9,800 vs H2 2025 9,654; less income tax ~18%, NCI ~7% and perpetual-bond coupons ~1,225) LESS equity retained to grow the ordinary equity base 4% (0.04 x 129,511 FY2025 ordinary equity = ~5,180). Reported OCF - capex (FY2025: -55,582 - 727 = -56,310; FY2022 +39,446) is client-money, repo and trading-book flow and is not used, which is why the FCF CAGRs are null.
inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero: no share-based payment scheme disclosed in the FY2018-FY2025 annual reports (StockBasedComp blank in the CSV every period; basic = diluted EPS through FY2025, 1.68 FY2025). Interest income (RMB12,256m FY2025) is margin-financing and bond-carry revenue, not surplus-cash yield, and stays inside revenue. House and street bases coincide; band_position is degenerate.
inputs.fx_note: fx_rate converts CNY (model; the Company reports in RMB) to HKD (H-share quote): CNYHKD=X 1.1726 at 2026-10-16T22:18Z, Yahoo Finance chart API. The Shenzhen A share (000776.SZ) closed at CNY 19.27 = HKD 22.60 on 2026-10-16, a ~35% A/H premium that is normal for Chinese brokers, so the dual listing is not a parity check. Per-share values are per ordinary share and apply equally to A and H shares.
inputs.fy0: FY2026E (year ending 2026-12-31, unreported: H1 2026 actual + H2 estimate; Q3 2026 results due late October)
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z HKEX regular close (Friday); valuation dated the following day
inputs.capital_anchor: Ordinary shareholders' equity at 30 Jun 2026 = equity attributable to owners 176,788 less perpetual subordinated bonds 38,640 = RMB138,148m, RMB17.65/share on 7,824.8m shares (the interim's own figure is RMB17.74, line 455-457, on a slightly different numerator). FY2026E year-end ordinary equity ~143,000 after H2 profit and the RMB1,956m interim dividend. Parent-company net capital RMB114.6bn, core net capital 78.2bn, risk coverage ratio 233.2% vs 100% minimum, net capital/net assets 73.4% (interim line 488-498): regulatory capital is not binding; retention is charged for balance-sheet growth, not a regulatory shortfall.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Single CNY cost of equity 11.0% in every scenario (risk is charged once, through the scenario weights, not by moving the discount rate). Built in the flows' own currency: 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8% (ASSUMPTION: not fetched; the PBOC easing cycle has had the 10Y CGB in the 1.6-2.0% range since 2025) + beta ~1.3 x China ERP ~6.5% = ~10.3%, plus ~0.7pt for what a CSI-300 ERP does not price for an H-share holder: capital-account/RMB convertibility risk, 10% H-share dividend withholding, a history of CSRC sanctions that suspend fee lines (2019 OTC derivatives, 2020 Kangmei underwriting ban), no controlling shareholder but state-linked Guangdong ownership, and no buyback lever of size. Half a point above the 10.5% used for the joint-stock bank 0998.HK this month: a broker's earnings halved from FY2021 to FY2023 while the bank's did not. The market-implied cost of equity at 0.81x H1 2026 book with ~9% through-cycle ROE and 3% growth is ~10.4%, so 11% is a deliberate value stance; the sensitivity grid shows 10%. Hurdle for entry price is the house 15%.
inputs.lease_treatment: IFRS 16 right-of-use depreciation (inside D&A, RMB1,092m FY2025) and lease-liability interest (RMB33.7m) sit inside operating expenses, i.e. inside the pre-tax margin. lease_cost_pct_path is zero so the charge is not taken twice; lease liabilities (RMB523m non-current) are not deducted as debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, inside the 'cash_tax_rate' deduction: the margin is calibrated to PROFIT BEFORE TAX and the deduction rate covers income tax (FY2025 3,021 = 16.8% of PBT 17,973; H1 2026 18.8%; 10-11% in the weak years FY2023-24 because tax-exempt fund-dividend income is a larger share), profit attributable to non-controlling interests (FY2025 1,251 = 7.0%; H1 2026 7.1%; 10.1% in FY2023 -- the 45.5% minority in GF Fund is less cyclical than the parent so its share rises in weak years) and distributions to perpetual-bond holders (FY2025 918 recognised, annual line 19452; RMB1,225m/yr run-rate on the RMB38,640m now outstanding at a 3.17% weighted coupon, interim note 48). FY2025 total 28.9% = (17,973 - 12,783) / 17,973 where 12,783 is net profit to ordinary shareholders. Other equity instruments (38,640) and NCI (6,996) are therefore NOT deducted again in a bridge. NetIncome in the CSV is profit attributable to owners INCLUDING the perpetual holders' entitlement; the model works from the ordinary-shareholder figure.
inputs.notes: MODEL: securities broker-dealer -> dcf-methods routing row 'Bank, non-bank deposit taker, thrift' (closest row; the business is a leveraged financial intermediary whose balance sheet is client money, margin loans, repo and a trading book). Run as FCFE at cost of equity through the component engine, the house precedent for financials (0998.HK, 1658.HK, HSBC, LYG, WF, NAB.AX and others). First valuation of this ticker, no MEMORY.md entry. Not an owner-FCF DCF: reported FCF swings from +39bn (FY2022) to -56bn (FY2025) on client-fund and trading-book flows, exactly as the financial-parser flagged; net debt is zero by construction and no debt or cash is bridged. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = IFRS total revenue; ebitda_margin = pre-tax profit margin (after staff costs, interest expense, impairments and share of associates -- E Fund's 22.65% contributes ~RMB1bn/half); sbc, D&A, leases and working capital all zero; cash_tax_rate = income tax + NCI + perpetual-bond coupons, so EBIT x (1 - rate) = net profit to ORDINARY shareholders; capex = equity retained to grow ordinary shareholders' equity at the scenario's balance-sheet growth rate (g_E x prior-year ordinary equity, as % of revenue), so FCF = FCFE = distributable earnings. Terminal growth applies to FCFE at the cost of equity; terminal_cap_multiple 18x FCFE is above the Gordon multiple in every scenario (12.9x base, 13.8x bull, 12.1x bear) and does not bind. KEY FINDING: the valuation is a through-cycle ROE question. Ordinary-equity ROE was 8.6% (FY2019) 10.6 10.7 7.1 5.6 7.5 10.2 (FY2025), mean 8.6%, and ~16% annualised in H1 2026 at the top of a turnover boom (A-share turnover +97% YoY). The base case normalises revenue 15% below FY2026E over two years and holds ROE ~8.5% against an 11% cost of equity, which is worth ~0.7x book; the H share trades at 0.81x H1 2026 ordinary BVPS (0.78x FY2026E). Bull is ROE reaching the cost of equity (1.0x book); bear is a FY2022-23 downturn from a higher cost base (0.4x book), where FCFE drops below the ~RMB4.7bn ordinary dividend and the payout is funded by perpetuals, as it was in FY2022-23 (perpetuals 1.0bn -> 22.5bn). QUALITATIVE CONTEXT: 1776.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-17) landed mid-build and was read before the drivers were finalised; it confirms them without moving a path (profit alert +85% H1 2026 realised at +80%; risk coverage 233%; interim dividend RMB2.5/10 shares = 16.8% payout; HK$2.15bn CB due 2027 at HK$19.82; sell-side H targets HK$17-26, mean ~21.5, which sits at this model's bull case because the street capitalises the boom year). Valuation date is 9.5 months into FY2026, so FY2026E is fy0 (not discounted) and the first discounted flow is FY2027; the FY2025 final dividend (RMB0.50/share, paid mid-2026) and the FY2026 interim (RMB0.25/share, RMB1,956m) are paid out of fy0 and are not double-counted.

bear.growth_rationale: A FY2022-23-type downturn from a higher base: revenue fell 22% from FY2021 to FY2022 and net profit 36% to FY2023. Here revenue falls 25% in FY2027 and 8% in FY2028 (to ~40.7bn, below FY2025 but above FY2023's 32.1bn), then grows 2-3% under fee compression and the state-driven consolidation that leaves GF outside the ~10 national champions.
bear.margin_rationale: FY2023 margin was 27.2% and FY2018 28.5% at the last two troughs; the cost base is now larger (H1 2026 staff costs +57%). Bear troughs at 28% in FY2028 and recovers only to 32%: interest expense on a bigger repo/bond book is sticky, trading-book marks turn negative (FY2025 already carried a derivatives loss inside the net investment gain), and a CSRC sanction of the 2020 kind suspends a fee line.
bear.capex_rationale: Ordinary equity still grows 3.5% in FY2027-28, 3.0% FY2029-31, then 2.5%: in FY2022-23 the Group kept growing the balance sheet (assets +15% and +11%) through the downturn and funded it with RMB21.5bn of perpetuals. FCFE in FY2028 (~RMB2.3bn) is below the ~RMB4.7bn ordinary dividend; the dividend is either cut or funded by more perpetuals/placings, which the flat share count understates. Terminal ordinary equity ~RMB189bn; terminal ROE ~5.9%.
bear.tax_rationale: Tax falls to ~13% in weak years (FY2023 10.1%) but NCI rises to ~9-10% (GF Fund's minority share of a less cyclical profit) and the fixed RMB1,225m coupon is ~10% of a ~12bn PBT.
bear.terminal_note: Gordon 1.025/0.085 = 12.1x FCFE; cap does not bind. Terminal P/B ~0.40x on ROE ~5.9% -- where GF's H share traded in 2022-24.
bear.narrative: The cycle turns: turnover halves from the H1 2026 peak, trading-book marks go negative, revenue drops ~30% over two years and the pre-tax margin troughs at 28%. ROE ~5-6% against an 11% cost of equity; FCFE falls below the dividend for two years and the stock reverts to the 0.4x book it traded at in 2022-24.

base.growth_rationale: Revenue falls 12% in FY2027 and 3% in FY2028 as A-share turnover normalises from the H1 2026 doubling and net investment gains (RMB15.0bn in H1 2026 alone vs 12.8bn for all of FY2025) revert; FY2028 revenue ~50.4bn is ~14% above FY2025, i.e. the FY2025 level plus two years of 5%-type trend in AUM and margin balances. Thereafter 4% fading to 3%: household financial-asset allocation and public-fund AUM growth (RMB39.7tn, +15% YoY) offset by brokerage and fund-fee compression.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin on total revenue. FY2019-25: 37.0, 39.5, 38.5, 34.5, 27.2, 33.5, 40.6%, mean 35.8%; FY2026E ~43% (H1 46.0%). Base 38.5% in FY2027 then 37%: operating leverage runs in reverse as revenue normalises, with staff costs (RMB7.1bn in H1 2026, +57%) partly variable and interest expense sticky.
base.capex_rationale: Equity retained to grow ordinary shareholders' equity 4.0% a year for FY2027-30, 3.5% FY2031-32, 3.0% FY2033-36, from FY2026E ordinary equity ~RMB143,000m (H1 2026 138,148 + H2 profit - interim dividend). Ordinary equity grew 5.7%/yr FY2020-25 on a ~35% payout plus placings; the balance sheet grew every year FY2021-25 (total assets 536bn -> 975bn) and 22% in H1 2026 alone, and the January 2026 raise is earmarked for offshore subsidiaries, so capital is being deployed even though the risk coverage ratio (233%) is far above the minimum. Retention / revenue: 0.04 x 143,000 / 51,920 = 11.0% in FY2027, falling to 8.9% as equity growth converges on terminal growth. Terminal-year ordinary equity ~RMB202bn; terminal ROE ~8.6%.
base.tax_rationale: Income tax ~17% of PBT (FY2025 16.8%, H1 2026 18.8%) + NCI ~7.5% (FY2025 7.0%, higher when the parent's trading profit falls) + perpetual-bond coupons RMB1,225m/yr = 6.4% of FY2027 PBT (~19.3bn), 7.0% of FY2028 PBT; the coupon is fixed in RMB so the percentage drifts down to ~5.5% by FY2036 as PBT grows. FY2025 actual total 28.9% on a 40.6% margin year.
base.terminal_note: Gordon on FY2036 FCFE at 11.0% - 3.0% = 12.9x; the 18x cap does not bind in any scenario. Implied terminal P/B ~0.72x on terminal ROE ~8.6%, consistent with (ROE - g)/(CoE - g) = 5.6/8.0.
base.narrative: The boom fades to a normal market: revenue settles ~15% below FY2026E by FY2028, pre-tax margin 37%, ordinary ROE ~8.5% against an 11% cost of equity. FCFE ~RMB7-8bn in FY2027-30 (above the ~RMB4.7bn ordinary dividend; the surplus funds balance-sheet growth) rising to ~RMB11bn by FY2036. Terminal P/B ~0.7x.

bull.growth_rationale: A multi-year Chinese equity bull market (2014-15 or 2019-21 pattern): turnover stays near H1 2026 levels, margin balances and fund AUM compound, GF's No.3 revenue rank and Greater Bay Area / offshore build-out (January 2026 raise deployed) add share. Revenue only dips 3% in FY2027 and grows 5-6% through FY2032.
bull.margin_rationale: FY2020-21 margins were 38.5-39.5% in a good market and FY2025 40.6%; H1 2026 46.0%. Bull holds 40%: scale on a largely fixed cost base, E Fund and GF Fund associate/subsidiary income compounding with AUM.
bull.capex_rationale: Ordinary equity grows 5.0% FY2027-30, 4.5%, 4.0%, 4.0%, then 3.5%: a bull market is when the balance sheet (margin lending, market-making) is deployed fastest. Terminal ordinary equity ~RMB218bn; terminal ROE ~11.0%, i.e. at the cost of equity.
bull.tax_rationale: Tax ~17.5% + NCI ~7% + fixed RMB1,225m coupons at ~5% of a larger PBT, drifting to ~4.5%.
bull.terminal_note: Gordon 1.035/0.075 = 13.8x FCFE; cap 18x does not bind. Terminal P/B ~1.05x on ROE ~11%.
bull.narrative: The bull market runs for years: revenue compounds 5-6% off a near-FY2026E base, margin 40%, ROE reaches the 11% cost of equity and the stock is worth book. FCFE ~RMB10bn in FY2027 rising to ~RMB16.5bn; payout can rise well above the current ~35%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (above the 15% house default, below the 35% used for the joint-stock bank 0998.HK): the starting point is the top of a turnover boom (H1 2026 profit +80%, A-share turnover +97%), the last two peaks (FY2015, FY2021) were followed by profit declines of 60% and 36%, and the trading book is 29-44% of revenue. Bull 25% (above 0998.HK's 20%): unlike a bank, a broker captures a continuing bull market with high operating leverage, the January 2026 raise funds offshore growth, and the state is actively promoting equity financing and long-term capital inflows. Base 45%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
